title: Onboarding hints and loading tips
player_outcome: New players are guided like a modern game: unobtrusive contextual hints ('Hold LMB to chop the tree', 'Night is coming — build a shelter', 'Place a torch', 'Talk to the Guide'), first-boss and progression nudges that link into the Guide book, and loading-screen tips; all can be turned off.
design: Core HintDirector driven by milestones/journal (P5-25) and the progression advisor (P5-27); data/hints.json; game/UI hint toast layer (theme); loading tips on world load screen; setting to disable.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
